Page 44 1946 In Nomine Domini Jesu incipit
Jan. 13th "Long Distance" 5:20 P.M. " .... Mother - Anna Saile Scheduled to receive shock to-morrow. Dr. say will either kill or cure her.
Page 45 In Nomine Domini Jesu Christi 1945, October
Oct. 10 Mrs. Brigid Ronan - 68 - of 356 W. 25th, N.Y., City - Enrolled here Sept. 6 - with 50c for Poor Souls - for what seems very threatening cancer - lost her left breast five years ago. Now causing much trouble. They fear another operation ... Enrolls PP. Souls again promising more frequent Communion.
November
1945, November
Nov. 10 Michael Solazzi - 2 - very peculiar poralysis - seems quite in- telligent but neither stood or sit, nor say a word or hold his head erect. Enrolled To-day 1.00 - parents promising more fre- quent Communion ...
12 Joseph Newwan - non Catholic - 49 - of Bellrose L. I. - blind for eight years; Enrolled Today - 3.
Page 46
1945, December
Dec. 12 10:30 P.M. Have just Enrolled (5.) the young genius - musical - Jimmey Sarchet in the Seraphic Masses - Only 14 yrs. old has mas- tered piano and three other instruments. Now paralized, blind, and deaf but still as cheerful as ever.
February
1946, February
Feb. 15 V. Sister Elizabeth Anthony of Newport L. I.
Catherine Mahon - Woodside L.I. (25) last ... given up by all doc- tors - was enrolled ... also later on Poor Souls were enrolled for that intent .... Now seemingly on way to recovery - lost nearly half of her brain.
19 Timothy Conery - 54 - threatening lower-gumb. Enrolled Enrolled in Ser. Masses - 1.00 Promising Poor SS. special enrollment if Dr. get a surprize. March Ist here again today to keep said pro- mise.
1946, March
March Mar. 29 David Peterson enrolled last Friday 22nd for headaches and stomach trouble. Mrs. Peterson reports To-day "remarkable improvement.
